present.description: If true, files in /oath/store/pkg/<name>/<hash>/bin/ are symlinked at /bin/<basename>. If false, those links are removed. The store tree stays.

url.description: If non-empty, apply wget's this URL into the store when present (local store wins if already there). A .tar URL is a pack tree; an origin prefix plus hash fetches {url}/pkg/{name}/{hash}.tar. Object storage is just HTTPS.

hash.description: Pin: realization id sha256-<64 hex> of the pack tree (oath-tree-v1). Apply verifies. Empty is discovery (fetch or unique on-disk tree reports actual.hash).

requires.description: Hardware this package needs. Apply present=true is refused if unmet. Uninstall is always allowed.

drm_modifiers.description: Connected GPU must export Vulkan WSI DRM format modifiers. AMD GFX6–8 (SI/CIK/Polaris) and virtio-gpu do not. pkg:gamescope always requires this even if the field is omitted.
